urls.title: PDF URLs
urls.description: Direct URLs of PDF files (https:// is added when missing). Duplicates are skipped.

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Only extract the first N pages. 0 means all pages.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: document: one row per PDF. pages: one row per page (each row repeats the document metadata).

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: PDFs larger than this are skipped with error file_too_large and not charged.

timeoutSecs.title: Download timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a PDF download after this many seconds.
